# placement_vectors.txt - synthetic positive/negative pairs for the normal-building placement rule
# (MAP-BUILD-1 package B). Format: tools/placement_ref.py (docstring); contract: docs/sim/ship-placement.md.
# Every grid is the RUNTIME corner grid of the original (stride W+1; column W and row H are 0, docs/re/ship-founding.md
# 12.3). Rows not listed are all 0. `place <type> <x> <y> <rot> <flags> <rec8>`: flags 0x2000000 = analysis requested
# (the server derives the byte; rec8 is the untrusted client byte and must not matter). Expected values were derived by
# hand from docs/sim/ship-placement.md section 2 (rules R1-R6) before any program computed them (two of the first 50 were wrong when first run and were re-derived, see section 4 of that document); tools/placement_ref.py check and
# tools/placement_emulate.py vectors (the original code) both reproduce them.
# Expected: `accept <byte>` | `reject <REASON>` | `unsupported`; REASON -> engine Reject: BOUNDS=OutOfIsland, OCCUPIED=Occupied,
# TERRAIN and LOWLEVEL=TerrainRefused; `unsupported` = Reject::Unsupported (never an accept).
#
# type <id> <w> <h> <prodtype> <flag word hex> <replaceable>
type 1 2 2 97 0084 0       # house, flag word 0x84 (ordinary land); PIONIER-like, group 0x61
type 2 3 3 1 0084 0        # workshop 1001-like (HANDWERK 3x3, 300 gold), group 1
type 3 4 3 34 0084 1       # market-like 4x3, replaceable by the same PRODTYPE (HEAD[0x2e] bit 0), group 0x21
type 4 4 4 35 2087 0       # warehouse 1302-like, coast
type 5 3 3 2 0084 0        # farm 3x3, group 1: an alternate registry type of the same class
type 6 1 1 226 0029 0      # growing scenery: flag 0x20 makes it overlappable
type 7 1 1 323 003a 0      # stone: flag 0x20
type 8 2 2 97 0084 0       # an existing building of PRODTYPE 97 (not overlappable)
type 9 2 2 6 2087 0        # fisher-like, coast, 2x2 (alternate coast type)
type 10 1 3 6 2087 0       # coast type 1 wide: n = 2, the shore test is skipped
type 11 2 2 6 0004 0       # flag word 0x0004 (ordinary land without the 0x80 bit): alternate flag word
type 12 2 2 97 0094 0      # flag 0x10 set: coverage test not decoded -> unsupported
type 13 3 3 3 3096 0       # mine-like, class 0x3000 -> unsupported
type 14 1 1 198 4386 0     # bridge piece (BRUECKE), class 0x4000 -> not a BuildCmd class (MAP-ROAD-1: only PRODTYPE STRASSE is)
type 15 1 1 257 1886 0     # wall class 0x1000 -> rule decoded, not a BuildCmd class

type 16 1 1 193 4186 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: dirt road 2520-like, STRASSE, class 0x4000, mode 2 (min of the cell minima)
type 17 1 1 193 1186 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: dirt road 2527-like, STRASSE, class 0x1000 (slope test, level floor)
type 18 1 1 198 4386 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: a bridge piece on the island (an existing tile object), not placeable by BuildCmd
type 19 1 1 194 4186 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: class 0x4000 but PRODTYPE RAMPE -> unsupported
type 20 1 1 193 4185 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: STRASSE with F & 3 == 1 (single-quad average) -> unsupported
type 21 1 1 193 4187 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: data-defined STRASSE, mode 3 (window maximum & 0xf0)
type 22 2 1 193 4186 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: data-defined 2x1 STRASSE, mode 2
type 23 2 1 193 4184 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: data-defined 2x1 STRASSE, mode 0 (max of the cell minima)
type 24 1 1 193 1180 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: data-defined STRASSE, class 0x1000 WITHOUT bit 4: the class test does not run
type 25 2 1 193 4186 0     # MAP-ROAD-1: 2x1 land road for the occupancy order

case land_flat_30   # R3 flat 0x30 -> byte 0x30
  island 0 0 10 10
  v 0 3030303030303030303000
  v 1 3030303030303030303000
  v 2 3030303030303030303000
  v 3 3030303030303030303000
  v 4 3030303030303030303000
  v 5 3030303030303030303000
  v 6 3030303030303030303000
  v 7 3030303030303030303000
  v 8 3030303030303030303000
  v 9 3030303030303030303000
  v 10 0000000000000000000000
  place 1 3 3 0 2000000 0
  expect accept 48
end
